sections.heading: Sec. 9-368c. Misrepresentation of contents of a petition.

body: (a) No person shall intentionally misrepresent the contents of a petition circulated under this title.
(b) Any person who violates any provision of this section shall be guilty of a class D felony.
history: History: P.A. 23-22 made a technical change.
content.plainText:
(a) No person shall intentionally misrepresent the contents of a petition circulated under this title.

(b) Any person who violates any provision of this section shall be guilty of a class D felony.
